description: This file defines classes and functions related to fixture management and lifecycle in the Playwright testing framework, including Fixture, FixtureRunner, and related utility functions.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Represents a test fixture with setup and teardown logic, dependencies, and usage tracking.

classes.name: FixtureRunner
classes.description: Manages fixture instances, their setup and teardown, and parameter resolution for test functions.

methods.name: getRequiredFixtureNames
methods.description: Extracts fixture parameter names from a test function, considering its location.
